beats.headline: Hired at the bar
beats.text: Transaction logged at the Desperado Club. Clients: Crawler Carl and Crawler Princess Donut. Hired: Bomo, mercenary, and the Sledge, mercenary, sold as a set. Also present at the bar, at no charge: Elle and Imani. The cat orders a dirty Shirley, in a bowl, with extra cherries, and gets it, because the Desperado knows who tips. Bomo's transcript is short. That is a feature, crawler. The talking ones cost more.

beats.headline: Bomo casts smack protect
beats.text: Service upgrade logged at the Desperado Club, station 41. Clients: Crawler Carl and Crawler Princess Donut. On entry the Sledge casts magic protection, as before. Bomo now adds a shield spell, bought by Bomo, which stops physical attacks as well. His summary: the Sledge casts magic protect, Bomo casts smack protect. Assignment: stay with the client while he sits beside a drunk, one-handed crawler with skulls. When the crawler lets a small metal object clatter onto the bar, Bomo is between them at once, and several cretin bodyguards the client had not noticed are standing round them.

beats.headline: Part of the price of the Gate
beats.text: Contract amendment, filed by Quasar, Carl's new lawyer. Carl surrenders the Gate, on a temporary basis. In exchange: four mercenaries, free of charge. Bomo. The Sledge. Clay-ton. Very Sullen. Plus two spells, issued to Bomo and the Sledge, that copy two of the Gate's tricks: a jump to the stairwell, and Zerzura. So the client keeps the tricks, loses the object, and gets four bodies thrown in. Lawyers, crawler. Get one.

beats.headline: He moves them to the stairwell
beats.text: Service rendered. The hunters are about to be released and the clients want to be somewhere else, specifically the stairwell in Zockau. Bomo casts the spell he was issued, and Carl and Princess Donut are there. No fuss, no speech, no ceremony. Some mercenaries want to be thanked; this one has already been paid for, in Gate. Enjoy Zockau, crawler.

beats.headline: Punched twice, unbothered
beats.text: Service note. Bomo posts Carl's note in the Zockau tavern saferoom and waits there, as instructed, for close to two hours. The mantis merchant punches him, is frozen for a minute, says "wait for me", and punches him again, for which he is frozen for an hour. The saferoom is full of hunters. Bomo reports that they are scared of Bomo. He comes back with the mantis standing in the hallway behind him.

beats.headline: Clearing out Zockau
beats.text: Zockau is a ghost town. The hunters who dug in to hold its saferoom against the brambles all teleported away when the masquerade began, leaving their surplus sorted into little mounds on the floor. Stealing in a saferoom is as bad as killing; once the owner walks out, it is all fair game. Bomo goes in and comes back, by Mordecai's account, with armfuls of armor and swords, plus guns and power armor that are race restricted. Lots of stuff left behind, he reports.

beats.headline: Two stairwells, not far
beats.text: Subject is the last of the four cretin bodyguards still with the clients; the other three went down with the high elf castle. Services this morning: loaded his stairwell teleport, still on cooldown, to read the stairwell locations, and reported two, not far, still in the big city near the coast. Assigned to map the area on paper with Mordecai and to remain in the saferoom. Offered, as consideration, a GameCube controller. Response: a noncommittal grunt. Observed condition: depressed, possibly lonely, possibly missing the Sledge.

beats.headline: Built like a walking mech
beats.text: Order fulfilled at the client's workbench. One suit of armour for Bomo, as big as he can move in: unenchanted, very heavy, full of daggers, and built to break into dozens of pieces. Mounted on the shoulders, two six-packs of seeker missiles: six group stuns, six single-target anti-undead. Crawler Paz says he looks like a Battletech robot. Bomo has been playing Armored Core and is sore that there is no giant gun. On the run across the graveyard he fires his missiles and carries Paz, who is too heavy for him until Paz stows his breastplate. Delivered: one terrified man, to the temple door.

beats.headline: Sent to the Sledge
beats.text: Payment received, for once, rather than issued. Yemaya thanks Bomo for building her shrine, and he tells her it was easy, easier than Tetris. She asks what he wants. Maybe more games, he says. Then: no. The Sledge. I miss my friend. Where is he? Larracos. It is done, and Bomo is gone, moved to the ninth floor by a goddess standing in her own temple. The clients lose a mercenary, and with him the spell they were counting on to put them at the stairwell. Mongo whimpers.

beats.headline: The missile batteries
beats.text: Service rendered. Missile support for the offensive, piloted by Bomo and the Sledge from Shanty Town, within running distance of Princess Donut. The batteries themselves fire from Area 52 in the woods, on long-range magical triggers wired to two Trollish Portable Control Rooms, which a former crawler modified to mimic the cretin-sized controllers the pair already knew. A painted target appears on the screen; they select a missile; it goes. Stock at the start of the day: over fifteen hundred missiles. Florin paints a mobile tank and calls for chaffs and Mute missiles.

beats.headline: Cleaved in half at the door
beats.text: Final service entry. Bomo was guarding the base of the Nest tower with Toyotomi and a detachment of mages when a crawler with a dog came in. Toyotomi reported it. Bomo reported that he would stop her. Both reports came back marked from the deceased. All of them were cleaved in half with a spell. Bomo will supposedly regenerate on the tenth floor. The clients no longer hold his contract. Crawler Carl does not know if he will see him again.
